Hello and welcome to the assignments page for our course. All assignments are
posted here, and each one is due **Friday** of the week listed.

Note that, while you can find assignments here, submission itself goes through
the [course Blackboard](https://blackboard.syr.edu) — with one exception, the
Project Application, which is submitted through a Qualtrics link.

For how assignments are weighted, how group projects are handled, and the late
policy, see [Logistics](../logistics.qmd).

Each assignment page carries its instructions, any templates you need to
download, and the **Guidelines** that apply to it. Guidelines appear under the
assignment where they are first needed; later assignments link back to them.

::: {.callout-note title="Still to come"}
The Project Application and the two Excel workshops will be posted closer to
their due dates.
:::
